# c_karnten: independent in CK3 from 907
country_event = {
	id = kar_releasables.1
	title = kar_releasables.1.t
	desc = kar_releasables.1.d
	picture = CIVIL_WAR_eventPicture

	fire_only_once = yes

	trigger = {
		NOT = { exists = KAE }
		is_year = 907
		NOT = { tag = KAE }
		OR = {
			owns = 128
		}
	}

	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 24
	}

	option = {
		name = kar_releasables.1.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 20 }
		release = KAE
	}

	option = {
		name = kar_releasables.1.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 80 }
			128 = { limit = { owned_by = ROOT } add_unrest = 5 }
	}
}

# The Karolingian Empire is formed: the emperor may grant immediacy to the free counties and bishoprics of the Empire's heartland
country_event = {
	id = kar_releasables.100
	title = kar_releasables.100.t
	desc = kar_releasables.100.d
	picture = DIPLOMACY_eventPicture

	major = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes

	trigger = {
		tag = HLR
	}

	option = {
		name = kar_releasables.100.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 50 }
		add_prestige = 10
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { exists = KAE }
					OR = {
						owns = 128
					}
				}
				release = KAE
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { exists = LEA }
					OR = {
						owns = 129
					}
				}
				release = LEA
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { exists = ALS }
					OR = {
						owns = 75
					}
				}
				release = ALS
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { exists = SPE }
					OR = {
						owns = 77
					}
				}
				release = SPE
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { exists = MAG }
					OR = {
						owns = 52
					}
				}
				release = MAG
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { exists = HOH }
					OR = {
						owns = 4715
					}
				}
				release = HOH
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { exists = GRI }
					OR = {
						owns = 1873
						owns = 4722
					}
				}
				release = GRI
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { exists = ULM }
					OR = {
						owns = 1872
					}
				}
				release = ULM
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = kar_releasables.100.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 50 }
		add_legitimacy = 5
	}
}
